scenario_policy.rule_1: Observed reservoir data must remain separate from hypothetical dam-break parameters.
scenario_policy.rule_2: Mettur breach parameters must not be fabricated.
scenario_policy.rule_3: Reference case-study parameters must never be labelled as Mettur parameters.
scenario_policy.rule_4: Every simulation parameter must contain provenance.

OFFICIAL_STUDY.description: Parameters obtained from an authoritative Mettur-specific dam-break study.

ENGINEERING_INPUT.description: Parameters entered by an authorized engineer or project operator.

REFERENCE_CASE.description: Published dam-break case used to validate the NEERAKSH modelling pipeline.
